plain: Reinforcement learning where some or all of the preference labels come from a model instead of people.
eli5: A robot teacher, not a human one, picks which of two answers is better.
technical: Reinforcement learning from AI feedback: RLHF in which a feedback model generates the comparison labels used to train the preference model; in Constitutional AI (Bai et al. 2022) the harmlessness labels are AI-generated and the helpfulness labels human.
